english:
Summons a 6-shot <solar Golden Gun /> that lasts 12 seconds, draining 8.34% Super Energy per second. Grants <pve 60% /> <pvp [0%] /> Damage Resistance, increased to <pve 66% /> <pvp [15%] /> with <solar Knock 'Em Down />.

Each shot deals <pve 1,453 /> <pvp [393] /> damage and applies 40 stacks of <solar Scorch />. Shots cannot score Precision Hits, but benefit from <solar Radiant />'s damage increase.

Damage Falloff begins at 26 meters and decreases damage to 34.5% at 100 meters. ADS Zoom does not affect Damage Falloff.

Super Kills add a bullet to the Magazine and refund Super Energy. The refund begins at ~80% per kill, decreases by ~10% per kill, and bottoms out at ~12% per kill.

// Source lists Scorch as x40+10; the enhancement granting the additional 10 stacks is not identified.

source.text:
General Super Information
Damage Resistance: 60% [0%]
Damage Resistance +Knock'Em Down: 66% [15%]
Base Duration: 12 seconds, or 8.34% Super Drain per Second

6 Shot Golden Gun
Deals 1453 [393] damage and inflicts x40+10 Scorch per shot, without the ability to score Precision Hits.
Damage Falloff begins at 26m and decreases down to 34.5% damage at 100m. ADS Zoom has no effect on damage falloff (1x ADS scalar).
 Radiant's damage bonus affects its damage output.

Super Kills grant an additional bullet to the magazine and refund Super Energy.
Initially refunds ~80% Super Energy per kill, decreasing by ~10% per kill, down to a minimum of ~12% Super Energy per kill.
Tier 2 Super

Base Cooldown:
556 seconds
